about: What lib/layer-registry/layerPublication.js writes (mappingLayers ML3-a/b), as DATA. sssomSchemaReleaseText: R-e, the sssom_version enum admits only 1.0 | 1.1 (measured: '1.1.0a5' fails sssom validate), so the alpha the 1.1 slots were validated against is named in a declared extension. machineProducerKindList: the registered machine layers are judge layers (measured 2026-10-25: 45 of 45 member blocks inferred). droppedMachineColumnList: per-bridge match fields, whose CURIE prefix (EDUcoreHub) can name only one hub per curie_map while a version spans two hubs. legacySubjectExpansionPattern / legacyHubSourcePattern: what the pre-ML3 per-block export wrote (bridge-framework.js), kept declared under legacy_curie_map and as object_source. publicFilterFragmentPrefix: a filtered public rendering's mapping_set_id is the version URI plus this fragment and the filter digest (TQ Q37). authorIdSeparator: the SSSOM/TSV multivalued cell separator.
